rulingTitle: If an ordinary run receives the canonical ID but emits a different value in run.start data.runId, this test still passes.

action.reason: Real test-coverage gap: the AC-1 test stops at runSetupPhase and only asserts the runId passed in, never the run.start data.runId emitted at run-setup-init.ts:202. Production passes the runId straight through, so the risk is test strength only; fix needs a harness running real setup and capturing the log line, suitable for branch review.

rationale: Verified by reading the test and run-setup-init.ts: finding is accurate, but it is test-only with no known production defect, and the story hit its fix-round cap.
